title: Provably Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Continuous-Time Episodic MDPs with Poisson Decision Epochs
abstract: arXiv:2609.23127v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world reinforcement learning (RL) problems evolve in continuous time, where decisions occur at irregular, event-driven intervals rather than at fixed discrete steps. We study episodic continuous-time Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) in which decision epochs are governed by a homogeneous Poisson process and the reward and transition dynamics vary smoothly over time. We consider both a fixed number of jumps per episode and a fixed time budget with a random number of Poisson decision epochs. translated_title: 具有泊松决策时刻的连续时间情节式MDP中可证明高效的强化学习
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的强化学习（RL）问题在连续时间中演化，其中决策发生在不规则的、事件驱动的时刻，而非固定的离散步骤。我们研究了情节式连续时间马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中决策时刻由齐次泊松过程控制，且奖励和转移动力学随时间平滑变化。我们考虑了每回合固定跳变次数以及固定时间预算（对应随机数量的泊松决策时刻）两种情形。在时间维度上Lipschitz连续性的假设下，我们通过离散化利用局部平滑性，将UCRL（Auer and Ortner 2006）和Q-learning（Jin et al. 2018）扩展到该设置，对基于模型和无模型的算法均证明了 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 的遗憾界。最后，我们建立了与之匹配的 $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{2/3})$ 极小极大下界，表明该速率在对数因子意义下是最优的。
tldr: 该论文首次研究了决策时刻由齐次泊松过程控制的连续时间情节式MDP，在时间Lipschitz平滑性假设下通过离散化将UCRL和Q-learning扩展到该设置，证明了 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 的遗憾界并给出匹配的极小极大下界，表明该速率在对数因子内最优。
en_tdlr: This paper studies episodic continuous-time MDPs with Poisson decision epochs, extending UCRL and Q-learning via time discretization under Lipschitz smoothness to achieve $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret bounds, and establishes matching minimax lower bounds proving the rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors.
